message: 試される者、試す者

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if we're actually getting stronger.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's that all of a sudden?」

name: Synn
message: 「It just doesn't really feel real to me. Thinking about going into the real thing without a chance to test ourselves makes me a little worried.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why don't you try dueling Misa? She'd gladly take you on.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. That's an option.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, don't take a joke seriously, it'll just cause trouble.」

name: Synn
message: 「It was a joke...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To begin with, do you honestly think any of us are a match for you, the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't Melilot-san say it too? That maybe we're getting stronger together.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if you ask me that, I wouldn't know.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「When you don't know something, I think you should just ask someone who does~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thank you for that utterly reasonable and completely obvious opinion.」

name: Synn
message: 「So it really has to be Melilot-san, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Sacchin?! Just now... h-how much of that did you hear?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Right from the part where Nana-chan promised to treat me to cake~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I never said that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「And the part about me being whatever...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're the Demon Lord, right~? That's amazing~ Maybe I should get your autograph~\s05」
I'm lucky to be surrounded by so many people like this.

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone is gathered here together--what is the matter?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, doing special training this early in the morning? How dedicated!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「What are you here for yourself, Helena?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, today isn't about special training, it's just...」

name: Synn
message: 「How much stronger do you think we've gotten compared to before?」

name: Melilot
message: 「What would you do with that information if I told you?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well... I thought it might serve as some kind of benchmark...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Strength is something one naturally gauges for oneself」

name: Helena
message: 「Isn't he asking precisely because he can't tell?」

name: Melilot
message: 「An attitude of relying on others for every answer is not a good habit」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, fair enough...」

name: Misa
message: 「If only we could visualize it even a little bit...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Visualize it... like a stronger version of the President...」

name: Ria
message: 「Of Synn-kun, of Synn-kun...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Scribble, scribble~~ Something like this?」

name: Ria
message: 「I tried drawing what I was picturing in my head, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「I guess you can't really tell from this, huh\s02」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, this is actually quite a nice drawing!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah! Sis! Don't just grab it without asking!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Ho-ho. He is depicted here in a rather rugged yet gentlemanly, and fiercely courageous manner」

name: Melphas
message: 「His features are captured quite well too. However, I feel the toughness and gallantry might be just a tad excessive...」

name: Helena
message: 「Right? Synn-chan is a bit cuter than this, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, that's...\s03」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So this is supposed to be Synn\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「From what possible angle does this look like him...?」

name: Misa
message: 「I hate myself for not being able to understand my sister!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Melphas-san!?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Good day to you, Student Council President. The wintry wind chilled me to the bone and filled me with melancholy, so I inadvertently wandered indoors」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Trespasser spotted!!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Perhaps I was drawn in by a voice reminiscent of a babbling brook」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's this guy even talking about?」

name: Melphas
message: 「A passion as fierce as flames is the badge of honor for a lovesick maiden」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha--!? He really is a suspicious person!!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Please rest assured. I have not broken the law in any way」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right. The library is open to the general public on weekends only. So it's completely fine for him to come in」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh... is that so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. You know how the church is open on Sundays too, right? On Saturdays, people are free to come and go from the library starting in the afternoon」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, I had no idea」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is something you would naturally know if you made good use of the library on a regular basis, you know?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Y-You are...!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, I am currently on duty. Please excuse me」

name: Melphas
message: 「Please wait, Lady Melilot!!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Ah, you have grown so big and beautiful...」

name: Melilot
message: 「H-How do you know my name...」

name: Melphas
message: 「Presumptuous as it may be, I have had the pleasure of meeting you once before」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, Melilot~ How did a shut-in like you get acquainted with this person~?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I-I don't know him!\s01 I have no idea who he is!\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa~~, this is a first. Seeing Miss Melilot so flustered」

name: Synn
message: 「Indeed it is」

name: Melphas
message: 「It is only natural that you do not recall. After all, we met in the Demon World, when you were still very small」

name: Melilot
message: 「My past...!?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Beloved descendant of Nibe」

name: Melilot
message: 「Wh... How do you know about that...!?」

name: Melphas
message: 「I would very much like to be counted among those relatives myself」

name: Melilot
message: 「Guh... ugh...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I-I refuse! Furthermore, if you continue this conversation any further, I'll have you thrown out for obstructing official business!」

name: Melphas
message: 「That is unfortunate. However, I am sure time will eventually resolve the matter between us」

name: Melilot
message: 「Enough already!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey, you」

name: Melphas
message: 「My, my. To be addressed by yet another lovely lady--I feel as though I might faint from sheer bliss today」

name: Helena
message: 「Never mind all that. So, you know about when Melilot was little, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you tell her, I'll never forgive you!!」

name: Helena
message: 「It's not like I'm gonna ask about bed-wetting stories or anything~」

name: Helena
message: 「You've lived even longer than Melilot... which means you're a demon, aren't you?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Yes. Just as you say」

name: Helena
message: 「And I can tell you're packing some serious power, too!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Before love, I am always a powerless man」

name: Synn
message: 「If I'm not mistaken, Sir Melphas is also one of the Seven Demon Generals」

name: Melphas
message: 「Embarrassing as it is to admit」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, isn't that super convenient!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Helena
message: 「This is a great chance to gauge his strength. Go ahead and keep him company for a bit!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Keep company...?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's right! You're going to fight until you're battered and bruised! Against these girls--the Crusaders!」

name: Melphas
message: 「What...!! Courtship would be one thing, but raising a hand against a woman is completely out of the question!」

name: Helena
message: 「What's that? Are you saying you won't listen to what I tell you--?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Rather than scatter the blossoms of maidenhood by my own hand, I would sooner return to dust」

name: Helena
message: 「Tch. Then let's do this. A one-on-one duel with Synn-chan! You shouldn't have any complaints with that」

name: Melphas
message: 「Like I said, against a woman--」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm a guy!!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Ah, my apologies. However...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is it, staring at me like that...」

name: Melphas
message: 「For a young man, knowing when to back down is also crucial」

name: Helena
message: 「You're hardly at an age to be calling someone a 'young man'」

name: Melphas
message: 「Besides, it appears that you, the Student Council President, are an opponent against whom even Lady Melilot would struggle」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... i-is that true?」

name: Misa
message: 「Even Melilot-san would struggle...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't tell me, because you knew that...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why you wouldn't tell us!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is not true at all!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, please keep quiet in the library\s01」

name: Melilot
message: 「Kuh.... I-If you believe the words of such a suspicious and rude person, you'll end up paying dearly for it\s09」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, this person... can look at Ria's paintings and properly appreciate them, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「What does that even matter\s09」

name: Helena
message: 「It means he has a keen eye for discerning true value. After all, Ria's paintings are genuinely acclaimed all over the world」

name: Synn
message: 「What?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Winning prizes at prestigious competitions is practically routine for her, you know? To the point where we're running out of space to put all the trophies and certificates.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's only because you keep entering me without asking, Sis!\s09」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I had no idea... I never knew...」
Ria-senpai really is on a whole different level than I thought...

name: Ria
message: 「Don't worry about it, Synn. No matter what anyone says, I only draw because I love it.\s01」

name: Helena
message: 「It carries far more credibility than a certain someone who has no interest in--excuse me, no eye for--that brilliance--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Very well. If you insist on going that far, allow me to teach you.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The sheer gap in our abilities!!」
